facts.business: Viksit Engineering Limited was under corporate insolvency resolution process and has not carried out regular business operations; new promoters intend to revive operations and introduce new business opportunities.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on implementation of approved resolution plan under IBC (Note 29) and going concern uncertainty due to eroded net worth and lack of regular operations, though financial statements prepared on going concern basis due to new promoters' revival plans (Note 30).

key_risks: Company has not carried out regular business operations
Significant doubt on ability to continue as a going concern
Dependence on successful implementation of NCLT-approved resolution plan
New promoters and management yet to revive operations and introduce new business opportunities
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company has not entered any Related Party Transactions. There are no materially significant related party transactions made by the Company with Promoters, Directors, Key Managerial Personnel or other designated persons which may have a potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large.
